blocks.x: Can we stop now? Because we’re overwhelmed and we don’t want to get in your way.
But you know this is - what do you call this thing? What’s this thing called? Library of Congress? I mean, am I too primitive for this?
Smithsonian. No, it’s Smithsonian. Big, big, yeah...
I mean, is this something they can work with or relate to?
